ns2:section.sectionText: Students must enroll in both 35110 and 47160. This part of the course meets 8:00 am to 5:00 pm on the following Saturdays: January 31, February 14, February 21, February 28, and March 14. March 7 is an alternative rain day. Class will meet in different locations around campus and at Allerton Park. Enrollment in this course requires approval of the instructor. Please contact Professor Gertner at gertner@uiuc.edu to request permission to enroll.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Forestry or Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s).
